title: Bosnia Mostar to Sarajevo Mountain Route
region: Bosnia Mostar to Sarajevo Mountain Route
slogan: Mostar to Sarajevo · 97 km home again

waypoints.advice: Mostar is where the day begins. Next is Jablanica, 48 km on.

waypoints.name: Ivan Sedlo
waypoints.advice: Ivan Sedlo, late in the day at 967 m. The road climbs 967 m over the 48 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Sarajevo, 48 km on and mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Mostar → Jablanica is 44 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Jablanica → Konjic is 20 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Konjic → Ivan Sedlo climbs about 967 m in 15 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ivan Sedlo → Sarajevo drops about 967 m over 41 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

facts.v: Bosnia Mostar to Sarajevo Mountain Route

scenicChapters.title: Bosnia Mostar to Sarajevo Mountain Route
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Ivan Sedlo → Sarajevo
scenicChapters.narrative: 66 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
